svg.title: splash
svg.desc: Opening architecture card for Digital Organism Theory (a proposed model of reality): T × E as the speculative source (before and after, and what allows it), the emergence of Big C, Big C stabilizing itself and then building Reality Frames RF₁…RFₙ and RF₀ as tools, and Little c₁ and peers c₂…cₙ living by the rules of RF₀ and others.

g.text: A PROPOSED MODEL OF REALITY · BOOK ONE
T × E — before, after, and what allows it
Big C emerges and stabilizes itself
Then it builds tools — worlds with rules
See the rules. Choose with others.
